summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including improvements to the Spark integration and the introduction of new features in the REST spec. Recent updates also include the release of Iceberg 1.11.0 and ongoing discussions about memory management during large writes and incremental computation for statistics maintenance.
highlights: Discussion on auto flushing data files to manifests
Proposal for incremental computation in compute_table_stats
REST spec discussion on generic CatalogObjectIdentifier
